podcast.title: Brief Stints with Grunge and Indie Bands
podcast.body: For a period, Donna Dresch played with "the guys," including a stint as a member of the Seattle grunge band Screaming Trees and touring Australia playing bass for Dinosaur Jr. These experiences highlight her diverse musical background before forming Team Dresch. "Donna was a member of Seattle Grunge Ben Screaming Trees for a bit and toured Australia playing bass for dinosaur junior."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Zine Publisher and LGBTQ+ Advocate
podcast.body: Donna Dresch had her own zine in the late 1980s and early 1990s, and became a vocal proponent for LGBTQ issues "long before we used the term, LGBTQ." Her indie label, Chainsaw, was named after her zine. "She had her own Zine in the late 80s and early 90s and became a vocal proponent for LGBTQ issues."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Semi-Solo Post-Riot Grrrl Supergroup
xref.body: Team Dresch was described as a "semi-solo post-Riot Grrrl supergroup" centered around Donna Dresch. The band continued the mission of the Riot Grrrl movement into a second wave of groups, maintaining its political and feminist edge. "Another group around at the same time, Slater Kinney was Team Dresh. This was a semi-soda post-Ryade girl supergroup built around Donna Dresh."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
